source.citation: Sepia portrait supplied by the project owner, Kevin Haas, on 12 November 2026 as the likeness to use for William L. Grey in the 1904 scene ("Use these as the models for William and Sarah Grey... since we do not have photos of them you can use these likenesses"). Sitter, maker and date not recorded.
what_it_does_not_supply: William L. Grey's own face, age, colouring or appearance: the sitter is not recorded
what_it_supplies: the proportions of the face the model of William L. Grey is drawn with, a stand-in chosen by the owner
the hair, facial hair and dress the figure is drawn in
